items.summary: Says she is committed to working with local elections officials to strengthen, protect and expand access to the ballot.
items.title: Work with county election officials on ballot access

citations.quote: Working hand-in-hand with our local elections officials to strengthen, protect, and expand access to the ballot

items.summary: Says she is committed to improving transparency in the state's elections, lobbyist registration and campaign finance systems, and to fixing delayed financial filings in the Secretary of State's office.
items.title: Improve transparency of election, lobbyist and campaign finance systems

citations.quote: Improving transparency in our elections, lobbyist registration, and campaign finance systems so that every Californian can make an informed decision about what issues, causes or candidates to support
Restoring Trust and Transparency: Fixing delayed financial filings in the SOS office, enforcing rules equally, and early bipartisan support for being fair and principled.

items.summary: Says she is committed to monitoring and upgrading the Secretary of State's cybersecurity policies to protect elections.
items.title: Monitor and upgrade election cybersecurity policies

citations.quote: Monitoring and upgrading the Secretary of State’s cybersecurity policies to ensure our elections are protected from attempts to undermine our democratic processes

items.summary: Says she is committed to revamping voter education outreach for formerly incarcerated people after Proposition 17 gave people on parole the right to vote.
items.title: Revamp voter education for formerly incarcerated people

citations.quote: Revamping our voter education outreach programs for the formerly incarcerated, especially in light of the passage of Proposition 17, which ensured Californians on parole have the right to vote

items.summary: Says she will run an outreach campaign across the state to urge Californians to take part in elections, including registering high school and college students to vote.
items.title: Statewide voter registration outreach

citations.quote: Encourage Californians to Vote: Running and aggressive outreach campaign to every corner of the state to urge Californians to get involved in the electoral process — from registering high school and college students to vote to helping members of the public get involved in our elections.

items.summary: Authored the California Act to Save Lives, signed by Governor Gavin Newsom in 2019, which set new standards on the use of deadly force by police.
items.title: California Act to Save Lives (police use of deadly force)

citations.quote: Dr. Weber was the author of and chief advocate for the California Act to Save Lives, landmark legislation passed and signed by Governor Newsom in 2019 setting new, higher standards on the use of deadly force by police.

items.summary: Authored AB 2466, which the Governor's Office says extended voting rights to people on parole, more than 50,000 Californians.
items.title: AB 2466: voting rights for people on parole

citations.quote: Dr. Weber authored AB 2466 extending voting rights to people on parole – more than 50,000 Californians

items.summary: Passed AB 2590, which gave judges discretion to apply restorative justice principles in certain sentencing cases, according to the Governor's Office.
items.title: AB 2590: restorative justice in sentencing

citations.quote: including AB 2590 which made California’s sentencing framework more flexible and effective by giving judges discretion to apply restorative justice principles in certain cases.
